videos.overview: The week's final visit is to Cambrian House B&B in Carno, Powys, where husband-and-wife team Jacqui and Ivan think their value for money will be unbeatable.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: The 1,000 episode sees auntie and niece duo Maxine Walker and Tegan Styles of Greenhills Hotel in Pembrokeshire get to the bottom of Tom's bathroom blues. Tom Beynon, owner of Three Cliffs Bay Holiday Park in south Wales also wants to know why he received a roasting for his hosting.

videos.title: Tay House
videos.overview: The competition kicks off at Tay House in Dunkeld, Scotland, where colleagues Mike and Kat are hoping their guests will find a home from home in their traditional Scottish hotel.

videos.title: Aberlour Hotel
videos.overview: The second visit of the week is to the Aberlour Hotel in Moray. Kellie and Alison host and take their guests on a trip to a local whisky distillery enjoyed by all but some cleanliness comments at feedback time leave them disappointed.

videos.title: Cobblehouse Country Cabins
videos.overview: Graham and Emma host the third visit of the week at Cobblehouse Country Cabins in Turriff, Aberdeenshire. After some fly fishing on the River Deveron and a DIY breakfast it's some fusty old furniture that leave the hosts floundering at feedback time.

videos.title: Trinity Boutique B&B
videos.overview: The final visit of the week is to Trinity Boutique B&B in Peterhead, Aberdeenshire, where host Yuliya reckons her interior design background will delight her guests. The B&Bers certainly find the furnishings fantastic - until one pair do some trash talking about their bin. Yuliya treats her guests to an afternoon in a prison, before wowing her guests with a rather substantial breakfast.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Payment day sees the holiday hosts meet one last time to find out what they've been paid and settle some scores. Mike and Kat are keen to get to the bottom of their disappointing breakfast scores, before Kellie and Alison dissect some design comments. After cutting questions, cleanliness concerns and a Moroccan mismatch, who will take home the title as the best value B&B?

videos.title: Haven House B&B
videos.overview: The new run continues in Leyburn, North Yorkshire, where hosts Iain and Tracey are boastful about their breakfast at Haven House B&B. But will facilities failures foil their chances?

videos.title: Southport
videos.overview: In Southport, can an Italian father and son clinch the competition with a cracking continental? Or will a sausage shortage scupper their chances?

videos.title: The Venue
videos.overview: Leah and Liv host at The Venue in Huddersfield where guest apartments sit alongside student accommodation. The guests are impressed with the low-cost comfort but the lack of a bathroom door is not very popular. The B&Bers enjoy an afternoon of crazy golf.

videos.title: Isabella's Yard
videos.overview: Katie and Rosie host at Isabella's Yard in Stamford, Lincolnshire. Tracey and Iain are blown away by their room, but Leah and Liv aren't sure that theirs measures up. The hosts treat their guests to a quintessentially British day out with afternoon tea on an old train- and the guests get steaming with plenty of bubbles on offer.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Payment day finds the B&Bers sharpening their knives ready to take each other to task over their feedback. Iain and Tracey want to know why their décor's been called dated when the wallpaper's only been up a week, and Fabrizio and Roberto have been losing sleep over one of their scores

videos.title: Northlands Farm
videos.overview: The first destination of the week is Northlands Farm in Chichester, where host Keith offers the full farm experience and an afternoon of paddleboarding on his very own lake.

videos.title: Mad Hatters Campsite
videos.overview: Claire hosts the second visit of the week at the Mad Hatters Campsite in Ely, Cambridgeshire. Martha and Lisa love the Wonderland theme but Giovanni and Enzo are not happy with the lack of ensuite.

videos.title: The Redan Inn
videos.overview: Lisa and Martha host the third visit of the week at The Redan Inn in Chilcompton, Somerset. The guests love the quirky interiors and breakfast goes down a treat but Giovanni and Enzo get picky about plates.

videos.title: The Limes
videos.overview: The final visit of the week is to The Limes in Maldon, Essex. Hosts Giovanni and Enzo hope their luxurious rooms will impress their guests - and the B&Bers are certainly happy to drink in the additional extras at check-in. They spend the afternoon at nearby Radio Caroline, the famous pirate radio station on a boat in Chelmsford. Breakfast dazzles most of the guests, and Giovanni and Enzo think they're onto a winner.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Payment Day sees Keith try to get to the bottom of the concerning cleanliness score that's been bugging him. Lisa and Martha are also keen to uncover why Enzo and Giovanni weren't blown away by their breakfast, before the boys turn the tables to quiz their rivals about some fussy feedback.

videos.title: Ocean Guesthouse
videos.overview: The first destination is the Ocean Guesthouse in Weymouth, where host Maxine finds some cleanliness comments concerning a marked mattress hard to swallow.

videos.title: Dartmoor Reach
videos.overview: Josh and Natalie host the second visit at their glamping site Dartmoor Reach in Bovey Tracey, Devon. Maxine finds herself hankering for a hotel after an unexpected guest in her tent and the vibes aren't as zen as the hosts would hope at the onsite yoga class.

videos.title: The George Inn
videos.overview: Gareth and Jonny host the third visit of the week at The George Inn in Plympton, Devon. The guests enjoy an afternoon at the zoo but Maxine has some cleanliness concerns.

videos.title: The Crown and Victoria Inn
videos.overview: The competition continues in Tintinhull in Somerset, at The Crown and Victoria Inn, where Surinder and Safia are hoping that their guests will give them the royal seal of approval.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Payment day sees Maxine confront Gareth and Jonny about their complaints with her mattress, and Surinder and Safia dust off their cleanliness criticisms.

videos.title: The Golden Grove Retreat
videos.overview: The first destination of the week is the Golden Grove Retreat in Carmarthenshire, featuring an afternoon of yoga and a healthy breakfast that leaves guests pining for a fry-up.

videos.title: Rosita Guest House
videos.overview: The rivals arrive at Rosita Guest House in Weston-super-Mare, where hosts Sheila and Phil dream of perfect scores. Things get off to a great start - until unexpected items turn up.

videos.title: King Square Apartments
videos.overview: The third visit is to King Square Apartments in Bridgwater, Somerset. Pam and Mya hope their self-catering digs will do the business, and the guests are certainly wowed by the building - but not the princely price tag.

videos.title: Hartridge Springs
videos.overview: The week's final visit is to Hartridge Springs in Upottery in Devon, where Anton and Emma hope their upmarket glampsite will bring a touch of opulence to the Great Outdoors. However, with some first-time campers among their guests, they've got their work cut out. The B&Bers try their best not to fall asleep while Anton talks about fossils on an open-top tram. At breakfast, the guests find out, it's quite hard to cook a fry-up without a frying pan.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Payment Day finds the B&Bers champing at the bit to tear some shreds off each other. Rob and Louise want to straighten out Anton's bed bother, while Pam and Mya prepare to give some cutting feedback about knives that aren't sharp enough. After everyone's had their say, the week's winners are revealed.

videos.title: The Gun
videos.overview: The first visit of the week is to community-owned B&B The Gun at Ridsdale. A visit to a birds of prey centre results in one guest's feathery hat getting some special attention.

videos.title: Marthrown of Mabie
videos.overview: The rivals go glamping at the Marthrown of Mabie site tucked away in a forest in Dumfries, where hosts Mike and Pam hope their guests will embrace the off-grid experience. Unfortunately, Louise and Kerry quickly find the loos to be bog standard, and get buzzed off by some uninvited guests in their accommodation.

videos.title: Dale View
videos.overview: The rivals are in the village of Holmrook in Cumbria, where Jo and Craig host at their Dale View B&B. The scenery is spectacular, but Kerry and Louise can't dust off their cleanliness concerns. After an afternoon aboard a steam train touring the Cumbrian hills, the guests bond over a few drinks. But Jo is left kicking herself after a poached egg disaster the next morning.

videos.title: The Cross Inn
videos.overview: The week's final visit is to the Cross Inn in Heptonstall, West Yorkshire. Eccentric hosts Gig and Lyndsey hope to impress with their 'one-of-a-kind' style. The B&Bers take it easy with a canal boat tour of the nearby waterways, before they're served gin by a giant sloth at Gig's gig venue.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Payment day arrives, and with some sore feelings festering, the B&Bers are ready to dish out the dirt on their competitors. Louise and Kerry want to know why Jo and Craig didn't like their B&B. Jo and Craig want to know why Louise and Kerry didn't like their B&B.

videos.title: The Sportsman
videos.overview: This week's competition kicks off at The Sportsman in Whitworth, Lancashire, where Steve and Georgia are hoping to win over their guests with bargain rooms and big breakfasts.

videos.title: Lahtle Wood Glamping
videos.overview: Sarah hosts the second visit of the week at Lahtle Wood Glamping in North Yorkshire, where she is joined in her duties by her sister-in-law, also called Sarah. The B&Bers find themselves cooing over the cabins when they pitch up, but Steve and Georgia aren't sure about the value. After a visit to an old air raid shelter, Steve drops some truth bombs on the other B&Bers about what he really thinks about the accommodation. Come feedback time, the Sarahs contend with some difficult comments about prices

videos.title: Cley Hall Hotel
videos.overview: Joe hosts the third visit of the week, at the stately, Grade II listed Cley Hall Hotel in Lincolnshire. The B&Bers find themselves steeped in history, before letting out some anger as they try out blacksmithing but a noisy night drives Paul to distraction, and both the Sarahs get a little too hot under the collar.

videos.title: Bumble Barn
videos.overview: The last visit of the week is to Bumble Barn Luxury B&B in Norfolk, where professional chef Paul and co-worker Debbie are looking to cook up a storm. Following a history lesson at an RAF museum, Paul indulges his guests by namedropping some of the illustrious people he's cooked for in the past. With expectations through the roof for breakfast, the pressure is on for him to deliver. However, some brutal feedback leaves Paul sharpening his extensive collection of knives ahead of Payment Day.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Payment Day sees backstabbing, blazing barneys, explosive confrontations and plenty of vendettas to settle. Steve and Georgia aren't happy with their breakfast scores, the Sarahs are angry about their hot tub's frosty reception, Joe's tossing and turning about his sleep scores, and Paul is ready to take everyone to task about some low blows in his feedback. When the dust settles, the winner is finally revealed.

videos.title: Rosaire Guest House
videos.overview: This week's competition kicks off at Rosaire Guest House in Llandudno, where host Jo and her mum Pat are going for a home-from-home vibe.

videos.title: The Queens Hotel
videos.overview: Rachel and Liam host the second visit of the week at The Queens Hotel in Harlech. Professional impersonator Liam is hoping to impress with his impersonations but an issue in the bathroom gives Pat a sinking feeling.

videos.title: The Mill at Glynhir
videos.overview: Visit three is to The Mill at Glynhir in Llandybie, Carmarthenshire. Mat and Helen are hoping their renovated mill will fit the bill. At first, their guests struggle to find fault - until Pat discovers that standards in the bathroom may have slipped. Things get prickly during a visit to a botanical garden in the afternoon but it's at feedback time that the hosts have the biggest thorn in their sides.

videos.title: Hideaway Escapes
videos.overview: The week's final visit is to Hideaway Escapes in Pembrokeshire, where sisters Lesley and Sarah are looking to inject a bit of colour into everyone's lives. The idea of getting back to nature bugs half of the B&Bers - and things get spicy when one set of guests refuse their room and take refuge in the car instead, leaving Lesley and Sarah all revved up come feedback time.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: With facility failings, bathroom blues and even one set of B&Bers refusing to even try out one of their rivals' rooms all on the agenda, Payment Day is set to be a feisty occasion. It remains to be seen who will emerge victorious when the dust settles.

videos.title: The Earlsdale
videos.overview: The week kicks off at The Earlsdale in Devon, where married couple Lewis and James hope their bold sense of style will prove a hit, although a dribbly shower rains on their chances.

videos.title: The Kings Arms
videos.overview: In Bude in Cornwall, the B&Bers visit The Kings Arms, where hosts Sally and Jo set out to give their guests the royal treatment. During the last visit, the pair were bullish about their spotless cleanliness standards - so, naturally, that's the first thing all of their guests check as soon as they arrive. And it comes back to bite Sally and Jo at feedback time, as they accuse some of their rivals of tit-for-tat marking.

videos.title: East Creek B&B
videos.overview: In Dorset, newbie B&Ber Hilary aims to provide a home-from-home at her East Creek B&B - which doubles as her actual family home. The stunning coastal views instantly earn Hilary some brownie points, but a lavatory let-down leaves two guests with a dilemma. After a visit to a sculpture park, Hilary has an awkward moment dealing with a complaint, leading to some low scores in her feedback.

videos.title: The Railway Ramblers' Rest
videos.overview: The final visit of the week is to The Railway Ramblers' Rest in Devon, where hosts Nikki and Terry hope their unique take on self-catering will secure them the plaque. However, simmering tensions between two of their guests threaten to derail things - and a simple breakfast the next morning isn't to everyone's taste.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: The B&Bers meet up on payment day to settle some scores and find out how much they've been paid. Cleanliness concerns are at the top of the agenda for most of the hosts, after one pair gave consistently low scores throughout the week. Allegations of foul play get the blood boiling, before the little pink envelopes come out and the identity of the winner is revealed.

videos.title: The Plough Inn
videos.overview: The first venue of the week is the Plough Inn in Ripple, Kent, where guests are treated to an afternoon of seal spotting, but are less than impressed by an old bath mat.

videos.title: The Old Crown Coaching Inn
videos.overview: The B&Bers head to Faringdon in Oxfordshire, where best friends Simone and Anke host the week's second visit at The Old Crown Coaching Inn. Roy and Brian find the furnishings fit for a king, but some of the guests find the cleanliness standards to be less-than sparkling. In the afternoon, a trip up a historic tower proves a step too far for Brian. Over a well-received breakfast the next morning, two of the guests ramp up expectations for their own visit.

videos.title: The Courthouse
videos.overview: The week's third visit takes the B&Bers to Great Bromley in Essex, where married couple Richard and Colleen host at their B&B, The Courthouse. The hosts reckon they're onto a winner with their breakfast, but it's the extra touches in the rooms that really get the B&Bers singing their praises. Tensions are released during a trip to a rage room in nearby Colchester, before Richard gets teary during feedback.

videos.title: Samsara Retreat, Kent
videos.overview: The week's final visit is to Samsara Retreat in Kent, where Lori hosts with her friend Mike. Lori hopes to provide a relaxing, re-energising stay, and sets about giving her guests an immediate taste of what her place is all about, with a yoga, meditation and gong bath session. However, come the next morning, some of their guests aren't feeling particularly rested.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: The B&Bers sharpen their metaphorical knives ready for Payment Day. The Plough Inn want to get to the bottom of their cleanliness comments, before Simone and Anke try to clean up Roy and Brian's marks about their mattress. Richard from The Courthouse is brought to tears by some feedback, before Lori and Mike put their sleep scores under the spotlight. After some heated debate, the payments are revealed and the winners announced

videos.title: The Art Bank
videos.overview: The competition kicks off in Kirkcudbrightshire, where Mandy and Suzanne at the Art Bank hope artistic flair will win them the week - but a shared bathroom is an instant black mark.

videos.title: Tithe Barn Hotel
videos.overview: The second visit of the week is to the Tithe Barn Hotel in Cockermouth, Cumbria where hosts Amy and Anna hope their host-less hosting won't put off their guests but the self-check-in causes problems for one duo. Mandy and Suzanne dig up some issues from their own feedback during a visit to a mining museum, before the journey to the off-site breakfast the next morning proves hard to swallow for some B&Bers.

videos.title: The Sanderling
videos.overview: On day three, married couple Dave and Meru hope their guests will love their traditional seaside guest house, The Sanderling in Morecambe. A walk along the Morecambe coast surprises some of the B&Bers, and a well-received bargain breakfast gives the hosts reason to be cheerful, but will some less-than-spotless cleanliness scores in the feedback tarnish their chances?

videos.title: The Curious Fox, Skipton
videos.overview: The week's final visit is to the Curious Fox in Skipton, North Yorkshire, where hosts Lee and Janette think their combination of rooms and fine dining will wow their fellow competitors. However, an unwelcome discovery in one room could scupper them.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Toilet troubles, bathroom bothers and some very picky comments are all on the agenda before the payments are disclosed and it is revealed who has won.

videos.title: The Red Lion
videos.overview: This week's competition kicks off at The Red Lion in Charing Heath, Kent, where the owners treat the other hosts to a masterclass in hospitality at nearby Leeds Castle.

videos.title: Glamp in Style
videos.overview: The competition continues in Battle in East Sussex, at Dean and Becky's Glamp in Style campsite. The hosts have novelty on their side, with their unique accommodation including a converted army truck, a horsebox and a vintage bus but not everyone is keen to embrace the alternative glamping experience. In the afternoon, Becky lets loose with a saucy tale amid the local fauna and flora and at feedback time, cold water leaves the hosts feeling the heat.

videos.title: Tottington Manor
videos.overview: Best friends Helen and Phil host the week's third visit at Tottington Manor in West Sussex. Sam and Claudia are bowled over by the decor, but some guests raise their eyebrows at the high prices. An afternoon at a local rum distillery makes Helen and Phil the toast of the town. The hosts can't stop smiling when they run through their feedback - until some comments right at the end spoil things and give Helen an axe to grind for payment day.

videos.title: Lakeview Studios, Dorset
videos.overview: Sam and Claudia host the week's final visit at their self-catering Lakeview Studios in Dorset. The digs get approving eyes from Claire and Lee, but Dean and Becky's arrival is marked by a problem with their toilet. Ahead of the all-important payment day, battle lines are drawn at a tank museum.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Payment Day promises to be a fiery affair after two sets of B&Bers in particular participated in tit-for-tat marking throughout the week. Eventually, the week's winner is announced.

videos.title: Home Farm B&B
videos.overview: The competition begins with Nick and Tim at Home Farm B&B in Milton Keynes, where secrets get revealed during a visit to the home of Second World War code breakers.

videos.title: The Vale Hotel
videos.overview: The week's second visit takes the B&Bers to Cricklade in Wiltshire, where Iain and Tayla host at The Vale Hotel. Their breakfast-free, no frills ethos has some of the guests worried, but it's the proximity to a main road that causes the most concern for one pair. Over drinks, the gang try an intimacy exercise that leaves Tayla in an awkward position, before the noisy neighbourhood is cause for much consternation in the feedback.

videos.title: Cottage Lodge Hotel
videos.overview: Francesca and Maurizio host the week's third visit at Cottage Lodge Hotel in Brockenhurst in The New Forest. The pair have a background in high-end hotels, and their green approach to hospitality leaves some of the B&Bers impressed but a tree hugging trip divides the group in the afternoon. The hosts' passion for local produce takes pride of place at breakfast but they're left with a sour taste over their facilities scores.

videos.title: Beach Sun Retreat
videos.overview: Husband-and-wife team Karl and Rohini host the week's final visit, at Beach Sun Retreat in Dymchurch, Kent. Their unusual offering proves an acquired taste for some, as not everyone finds the onsite meditation experience as relaxing as intended. Drinks on the pair's indoor beach brightens the mood, but some are left feeling less enlightened by the veggie breakfast the next morning.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: It's payment day, and the B&Bers are ready to take each other to task about some dodgy comments throughout the week before the payments are revealed and the winners crowned.

videos.title: The Dog Inn
videos.overview: The week begins at the Dog Inn in Longridge, Lancashire. Married couple Stu and Ali hope to impress their guests with a trip to a farm to see some baby lambs.

videos.title: Ullswater View
videos.overview: The competition continues at Ullswater View in the Lake District, where Julie and her friend Sarah plan to give the B&Bers a touch of luxury. The group brave wet, windy conditions during a boat trip on the lake, and vibrant views from the breakfast room boost everyone's spirits. Until a sausage causes a problem.

videos.title: String of Horses
videos.overview: The third visit of the week is at String of Horses in Cumbria where hosts Sue and Judith hope their guests enjoy the community feel of the place.

videos.title: Cove Farm, East Lothian
videos.overview: The week's final visit is to East Lothian, where husband-and-wife team Gavin and Rosie host at Cove Farm. They're hoping to persuade their guests of the merits of glamping, convincing their guests to embrace the great outdoors with a wood-fired hot tub. However, tensions brew during a trip to a local brewery - and they're not eased by a complaint about the sleeping situation over drinks.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Payment day finds the B&Bers trying to get their heads around all manner of things, from facilities faults to shoddy sleep scores. After a tension-filled visit last time around, there are plenty of scores to be settled, but whoever will reign supreme when the payments are revealed is anything but certain.

videos.title: Butterchurn Guesthouse
videos.overview: The competition begins in Northumberland, where karaoke-loving hosts Darren and Bobby hope to hit the high notes with their home-from-home B&B and a visit to Hexham Abbey.

videos.title: Hillside Hotel
videos.overview: The B&Bers take on a rope obstacle course suspended over open water in East Lothian.

videos.title: Bella Vista Lodge
videos.overview: The latest tour continues in Blackpool, where Paul and entertainer Victoria are keen to put on a show for the B&Bers at their Bella Vista Lodge. Will bingo and karaoke help Paul and Victoria to overcome their guests' preconceptions about the seaside town?

videos.title: North Star Sanctum
videos.overview: Simon and Lana host the week's final visit at North Star Sanctum in Fitling, East Yorkshire. The hosts look to lay on luxury with their lodges, so it's disheartening when one guest compares the place to a caravan park.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Payment Day sees the B&Bers take each other to task on everything from insufficient slumber to hopeless hosting, before the payments are revealed and we find out who's won.

videos.title: Laurel Bank Hotel
videos.overview: The competition kicks off at the Laurel Bank Hotel in Fife. Owners Lee and Emma come out swinging during an afternoon at an Edwardian mansion complete with its own golf course.

videos.title: Hidden Horizon Glampsite
videos.overview: Winnie and Ashley host the second visit of the week at Hidden Horizon Glampsite in Clydebank, where some guests enjoy the luxury of the plush glamping pods while others are left wanting more.

videos.title: Lemonfield Hotel
videos.overview: Father-and-daughter duo Jav and Sara host the third visit of the week at Lemonfield Hotel in Seaburn, Sunderland where their guests are treated to an afternoon of glass blowing.

videos.title: The Grays Hotel
videos.overview: Gary and Chris host the week's final visit at The Grays Hotel in Blackpool. The B&Bers are pleasantly surprised by the colourful rooms, before Gary regales them with tales of his childhood during a tram tour along the seafront. Everything seems to be going well, until the guests find some issues at breakfast.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: Tension abounds on payment day, with a number of suspiciously low scores throughout the week on the agenda. When the dust settles and the payments are revealed, who'll emerge victorious?

videos.title: The Abergwaun Hotel
videos.overview: This week's competition kicks off at the Abergwaun Hotel in Fishguard, Pembrokeshire. After a boat trip around the coast, owner Dan is quick to talk up his past career as a chef.

videos.title: Little London B&B
videos.overview: Catherine and Gareth hope the serene setting of their Little London B&B in Powys will see them cruising to victory. But one set of guests feel left out in the cold when they're shunted out to a glamping pod in the garden and only offered a reduced menu for breakfast.

videos.title: Let's Glamp Retro
videos.overview: The third visit of the week sends the B&Bers back in time, as Mark and Dawn host at their Let's Glamp Retro glampsite in Ceredigion. The hosts are extremely proud of their nostalgic, music-themed glamping pods - but not everyone appreciates the period décor.

videos.title: Ribble Valley Retreat
videos.overview: Married couple Emma and Peter host the week's final visit, at their Ribble Valley Retreat in Lancashire. After a relaxing night under the stars, Dan gets a short, sharp, shivering shock in the showers and Mark and Dawn are underwhelmed at breakfast.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: The B&Bers have had a smorgasbord of short-stay selections to scrutinise throughout the week, from traditional, cosy B&B vibes to '70s-inspired glamping pods. As payment day dawns, it remains to be seen which offering will win the week.

videos.title: The Firs
videos.overview: The competition begins at The Firs in Perthshire, where the B&Bers visit a local castle, and low cleanliness scores prove a particularly sticky point for hosts Lindsay and Pauline.

videos.title: The National Hotel
videos.overview: The B&Bers head north to Ross-shire, where Diogo and Rafael host at The National Hotel. They're hoping their traditional Scottish touches will have them on to a winner, but a peaceful night's sleep evades one set of guests.

videos.title: The Black Bull Inn
videos.overview: Janie and Paul host the third visit of the week at The Black Bull Inn in Dumfries and Galloway where the guests enjoy the deluxe touches, but a lavatory let down causes concern.

videos.title: Braeview Glamping
videos.overview: The B&Bers head to Morag and Jonny's Braeview Glamping in Berwickshire. A day out on the railway sees a head of steam building up beneath the guests' smiles as the tension of payment day looms, and the heat rises over the campfire as two sets of guests fail to see eye to eye.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: After a tension-filled final visit, payment day promises to be a feisty affair. Cleanliness standards have been questioned throughout, and the B&Bers seem set to fight dirty when the debate starts.

videos.title: The Kings Head Inn
videos.overview: This week's competition begins at The Kings Head Inn in West Sussex. Owners Colin and Oonagh arrange a visit to a Second World War aviation museum.

videos.title: The Roade House
videos.overview: At The Roade House in Roade, Northamptonshire, hosts Paul and Maxine boast a wealth of facilities including a yoga studio and hair salon but guests discover a pressing problem.

videos.title: The Halfway House Inn
videos.overview: Joanne and Julie host the third visit of the week at The Halfway House Inn in Morley, West Yorkshire where guests are impressed with the pub rooms but Paul and Maxine have a problem with the lack of shampoo.

videos.title: Stamford Meadows Glamping
videos.overview: The B&Bers sample the great outdoors for the week's final visit, at Sanath and Amelia's Stamford Meadows Glamping in Lincolnshire. The hosts hope their guests will embrace the bespoke touches at their luxury site. However, for one pair, the walk to the toilet facilities is a step too far.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: The B&Bers sample the great outdoors for the week's final visit, at Sanath and Amelia's Stamford Meadows Glamping in Lincolnshire. The hosts hope their guests will embrace the bespoke touches at their luxury site. But for one pair, the walk to the WC is a step too far.

videos.title: Westbrook Lodge Guest House
videos.overview: The week's first destination is Westbrook Lodge Guest House in Margate. The hosts hope their guests will like the animal-themed rooms, But they're not wild about the egg choices.

videos.title: The Casterbridge
videos.overview: Visit two of the week is to The Casterbridge in Dorchester where owner Noorani offers a classic English guest house with a Sri Lankan twist but some guests are concerned about the cleanliness.

videos.title: Overtown Manor
videos.overview: Nancy and her friend Henrietta host the week's third visit at Overtown Manor in Wroughton, Wiltshire. Nancy is hoping the homely feel to her farmhouse, which has been in her family for four generations, will impress her guests but plumbing problems cause an issue.

videos.title: The Castle Inn
videos.overview: The final visit of this week's competition is to The Castle Inn in George Nympton, Devon. Amanda and Josie aim to sweeten up their guests with a visit to a local honey manufacturer, but some dirty discoveries mean there's a sting in the tail for the hosts.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: After a week of dog poo diatribe, spicy omelettes and farm faux pas, the B&Bers meet one last time to have a big old row and find out who's won.

videos.title: Watergate Yard
videos.overview: This week's competition kicks off at Watergate Yard in Sleaford, Lincolnshire, where hosts Ryan and Hollie hope their unique style will impress. One guest gives the cleanliness standards a dusting down - although what the rivals will make of a creepy afternoon looking at 15,000 mannequins remains to be seen.

videos.title: Birdholme Glamping
videos.overview: Mum and daughter Holly and Meg host the week's second visit at Birdholme Glamping in Nottinghamshire, where they aim to make glamping even more glam with some extra luxury touches, but the self-catering setup doesn't impress their guests.

videos.title: Holly Hill Inn
videos.overview: Tom hosts the third visit of the week at Holly Hill Inn in Richmond, North Yorkshire. After a lot of bragging, expectations are high but it turns out his cleanliness scores aren't.

videos.title: Woodland Park Lakes Holidays
videos.overview: The final visit of the week is to Woodland Park Lakes Holidays in Windermere, where it's all about location for host Brittany. The competition has already seen some tit-for-tat marking, and the B&Bers waste no time in trying to root out issues in their rooms. They're soon smiling when Brittany lays on an arty afternoon, though faces drop when it comes to the cost.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: It's been a fiery week, with all of the B&Bers unhappy with their feedback - especially considering barely anyone has said they would like to return to one another's establishments. Fireworks seem in prospect as they meet up one last time to go over their scores and find out who's won.

videos.title: Clachan Garden B&B
videos.overview: The competition kicks off at Clachan Garden B&B in the Scottish Highlands. Things get off on the wrong foot with a shoes-off policy, before an afternoon at the pottery wheel.

videos.title: Highland Premier Glamping Pods
videos.overview: The B&Bers are still in the Highlands for the week's second visit, where Graham hosts at his Highland Premier Glamping Pods glampsite near Inverness. Graham hopes to inspire a spirit of adventure with an afternoon trying to track down the Loch Ness Monster. Unfortunately, Nessie proves a lot more elusive to find than furniture faults in the glamping pods.

videos.title: Cultybraggan Camp
videos.overview: Sandie and Chloe host the week's third visit at Cultybraggan Camp in Perth and Kinross. They're hoping to give their guests an arresting stay at their site, which was used as a prisoner of war camp in the Second World War. The unique history of the place has the B&Bers enthralled, but at feedback time, the hosts struggle to sweep a barrage of cleanliness concerns under the carpet.

videos.title: Uplawmoor Hotel
videos.overview: The week's final visit is to Uplawmoor Hotel near Glasgow, run by James and Neil. There are smiles all round during an afternoon of curling, but beneath the surface it seems some relationships between the B&Bers are on thin ice. Plus, a poor night's sleep for one pair leaves James and Neil feeling cranky about some of their scores.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: It's been a topsy-turvy week with some B&Bers delighted with their scores - and others not so much. After a little bit of a praise and a lot of moaning on payment day, it remains unclear as to who will emerge victorious.

videos.title: The Tiger Inn
videos.overview: The week begins at the Tiger Inn in Merthyr Tydfil, Glamorgan, where a stay packed with outdoor pursuits and local delicacies has been laid on.

videos.title: Hill House
videos.overview: The B&Bers are in Bath for the week's second visit, at Hill House. Hosts Tina and Alex plunge their guests into the famous city's history. But parking problems and a big old climb to the hotel's hilltop location mean it doesn't hit the heights for everyone.

videos.title: Romney Marsh Shepherds Huts
videos.overview: Kristina and Hanne host the week's final visit, at Romney Marsh Shepherds Huts in Kent. The rural location, breathtaking views and a trip to a vineyard have the B&Bers toasting the trip but in the morning, a lack of variety in the breakfast box might hamper the hosts' chances.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: The B&Bers fight it out for the prized plaque on payment day, with a packed agenda of score settling and emotional feedback.

videos.title: Highlights
videos.overview: A look back at some of the best (and worst) accommodation, low scores, tense arguments, dramatic moments and behind-the-scenes gossip.

videos.title: Inn Castledawson
videos.overview: This week's competition begins at the Inn Castledawson in County Derry-Londonderry, where the tranquil river views go down a storm, as does an afternoon boat trip.

videos.title: Drumrush B&B
videos.overview: Married couple Des and Mandy host the week's second visit, at their Drumrush B&B in County Fermanagh. The B&Bers embrace some inner peace with the stunning views and an afternoon of Pilates.

videos.title: Ballylough House
videos.overview: The third visit of the week is to County Antrim, where June and Stevie host at Ballylough House. The cleanliness standards immediately get a dusting down, but spirits are stoked by a visit to the world-famous Bushmills whiskey distillery.

videos.title: The Wylies B&B
videos.overview: Neil and Rush host the week's final visit at The Wylies B&B in Lisburn, Northern Ireland. The B&Bers feel pampered by the sleek, luxurious interiors and superb spa facilities and the hosts even offer their guests a pillow menu to ensure they have a great night's sleep.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: It's payment day and the B&Bers finally find out what they've been paid and who's won - but not before they've bickered about breakfasts, scolded each other's scores and clashed over cleanliness.

videos.title: Episode 46 - Redmire Village Pub
videos.overview: Kerrie and Vickie host at their cosy pub in the North Yorkshire countryside.

videos.title: Episode 47 - The Yorkshire Hosts
videos.overview: The B&Bers head to historic Harrogate to stay at Hollie and Ben's self-catering apartments.

videos.title: Episode 48 - Copper Beech Glamping
videos.overview: One B&Ber isn't enamoured with the idea of the great outdoors at a Staffordshire glampsite.

videos.title: Episode 49 - The Bull Inn
videos.overview: The B&Bers head to another homely pub, this time Ana and Dominic's place in Berkshire.

videos.title: Episode 50 - Payment Day
videos.overview: There are plenty of pernickety comments to unpick on payment day.

videos.title: Episode 51 - Sefton Blackpool
videos.overview: The new run continues. Do the B&Bers like to be beside the seaside? First host Andy hopes so at his Blackpool guesthouse, where he's laying on a day of arcades and ice cream on the beach.

videos.title: Episode 52 - The Apple Farm
videos.overview: The new run continues. The B&Bers have an udderly good time getting to grips with a very unusual cow during a visit to Charlotte and Matt's glampsite in Warwickshire.

videos.title: Episode 53 - Bechan Retreats
videos.overview: The new run continues. Karen and Bryan want to give their guests fever - cabin fever that is! They're immensely proud of their luxury lodges in Powys. Will their guests love them too?

videos.title: Episode 54 - Castle Inn
videos.overview: The new run continues. Tensions are already bubbling away between the B&Bers before they've even arrived at Ying and Jean's inn in Powys. But the hosts have a plan to restore harmony: pies.

videos.title: Episode 55 - Payment Day
videos.overview: The new run continues. It's payment day. Nowhere else will you find such consternation about whether a double bed is really a double bed if it's two single beds pushed together. Who's won?

videos.title: Episode 56 - The George Inn
videos.overview: The new run continues. Brothers Richard and Mick host at their Peak District pub. One guest does an impression of a bird in a cave. And can the hosts brush off some cleanliness scores?

videos.title: Episode 57 - Clementine's Guest House
videos.overview: The new run continues. In York, Laura and Lucy's guesthouse has all the B&Bers cooing. And then they take them all to eat a load of chocolate. Their chances are looking pretty sweet...

videos.title: Episode 58 - Haystacks Country Retreats
videos.overview: The new run continues. Jonny and Sasha encourage relaxation at their North Yorkshire retreat. And one B&Ber who's tense about tents gets some welcome relief when she digs her digs.

videos.title: Episode 58 - Cherry Tree Guest House
videos.overview: The new run continues up Bridlington way, at Cherry Tree Guest House - would you pay to stay? Could Simon and Carol win the week? Maybe not after a hairy discovery, eek! #NationalPoetryDay

videos.title: Episode 60 - Payment Day
videos.overview: The new run continues. After the high drama of stray hairs in drawers and grumbles about not having somewhere convenient to put a towel, the week draws to a close with payment day.

videos.title: Episode 61 - The White Lion
videos.overview: Hosts Grace and Conor get a grilling over breakfast options at their B&B near Crewe.

videos.title: Episode 62 - Foxlow Grange
videos.overview: Bathroom bothers besiege Sue's stay at Laura and Claudia's place in Buxton.

videos.title: Episode 63 - Cwmiar Holiday Cottages
videos.overview: Things get feisty on a trip to a farm when Eirlys and Demelza host in Carmarthenshire.

videos.title: Episode 64 - Tedstone Log Cabins
videos.overview: Sue and Roger host the week's final visit at their hand-crafted huts in Herefordshire.

videos.title: Episode 65 - Payment Day
videos.overview: The new run continues. After a particularly competitive week with plenty of gripes about value for money, which set of B&Bers reign supreme when the payments are revealed?

videos.title: Lovelady Shield Hotel
videos.overview: Na'im and Sara host first at their hotel in the breathtaking Cumbrian countryside. But one pair are too preoccupied with the furniture to care about the view.

videos.title: The Ryebeck Hotel
videos.overview: Neil and Jack host at their hotel near majestic Windermere, where the B&Bers enjoy yet more stunning views. But there's still negativity in the feedback.

videos.title: Dale2Swale Glamping
videos.overview: At Chris's glampsite in Richmond, North Yorkshire, off-grid really does mean off the electricity grid. Which is quite a worry for some of the B&Bers...

videos.title: Ashbourne Holidays
videos.overview: For the final visit the B&Bers go glamping again, at Phil and Jane's site in Derbyshire, where the stag-gering views include real-life deer wandering about the place.

videos.title: Payment Day
videos.overview: On payment day, the B&Bers clash over furniture failings and clock complaints. And sparks fly - ironically - over a lack of electricity. Who's won?

videos.title: Burnswood Boutique Escapes
videos.overview: Hosts Andrew and Diane are professional artists who've designed their establishment using all of their creative prowess, and the eclectic accommodation options are an immediate hit. But one guest thinks the facilities are lacking, and leaves some comments in their feedback that are difficult for the hosts to brush off.

videos.title: Ashby's Accommodation
videos.overview: Mubi and Steve focus on fun and wellness at their place in Portsmouth, Ashby's Accommodation. The luxury lodgings go down brilliantly - until one guest happens across some maintenance mishaps. At least a trip up a famous tower seems to leave everyone in high spirits.

videos.title: Bosham B&B
videos.overview: The third visit of the week is to Bosham B&B in West Sussex. Alicia runs the business from her own home, where she applies some extra homely touches for her guests' comfort. Unfortunately, the relaxed mood is pierced during evening drinks by an argument about online reviews.

videos.title: The Dog at Wingham, Kent
videos.overview: The week's final visit is to Marc and Matt's gastropub in Kent, The Dog at Wingham. The pair have raised the B&Bers' expectations throughout the week, and at first glance it seems they were right to do so. However, one visitor thinks they've got a 'ruff' deal with their room. The Dog is renowned for its food, so it's hoped a perfect breakfast will put Marc and Matt onto a winner.

videos.title: Payment Day (Fri 24 Oct 2025)
videos.overview: One guest's pernickety protests about a path prove pivotal in providing a plaque-winner as the B&B owners reconvene for payment day.

videos.title: Hoopers Sandy Beach Guest Rooms (1)
videos.overview: The ultimate B&B battle is back. Paul hosts the week's first visit at his seafront B&B in Swansea, where he's hoping stunning views and a watercolour masterclass will sail him to victory.

videos.title: Cae Court Hotel (2)
videos.overview: Steve and Andrew host the week's second visit at Cae Court Hotel in Bridgend, where the B&Bers raise a tostada to a brilliant Spanish brekkie

videos.title: Silver Fern Glamping (3)
videos.overview: The B&Bers visit Shaun and Sarah's glampsite in Aberystwyth, where a pair of resident diddy donkeys steal the show - and plenty of hearts

videos.title: Northop Hall Country House Hotel (4)
videos.overview: The week's final visit is to Fritha and Justin's country hotel in Flintshire, where things get frosty over al fresco drinks, and breakfast is chaotic

videos.title: Payment Day (5)
videos.overview: It's payment day following a wonderful week in Wales. The problem is, none of the B&Bers can agree on what exactly was wonderful about it.

videos.title: Norfolk: Three Horseshoes (1)
videos.overview: Fiona and Michael kick off the competition at their homely country pub in Norfolk. But a problem with a shower makes a guest feel dour.

videos.title: The Red House (2)
videos.overview: Carl and Liz host the week’s second visit at their coaching inn in Cambridgeshire, where converted stables and Highland cows are on the menu (not literally)

videos.title: Holly Lodge Boutique B&B (3)
videos.overview: Can an old-school Wurlitzer organ make the guests forget their grout doubts at Barbara and Elizabeth's boutique B&B in Norfolk?

videos.title: Peacock Lake (4)
videos.overview: The week’s final hosts, Helen and Carl, have their work cut out to impress at their Nottinghamshire glampsite after ruffling feathers with their feedback all week

videos.title: Payment Day (5)
videos.overview: Cleanliness has been the buzz word this week, with pretty much all of the hosts unhappy about their less-than sparkling scores. Have some of them been playing dirty?

videos.title: The Courtyard (1)
videos.overview: This week's competition begins at cosy pub the Courtyard in Falkirk, where guests pay a visit to the Falkirk Wheel, the world's only rotating boat lift.

videos.title: Finn Village (2)
videos.overview: The rivals arrive at Finn Village, Cliff and Monika's countryside place near Loch Lomond. A tranquil boat trip on the loch should help the hoteliers relax - but relations start getting choppy out on the water.

videos.title: Domes by the Sea (3)
videos.overview: Brothers John and Andrew host the week's third visit at the glampsite on their family farm in Dumfries and Galloway, where things get heated with saunas and hot tubs.

videos.title: Brooklands Guest House (4)
videos.overview: Sue hosts the week's final visit at her Victorian townhouse B&B in Penrith, where a marmalade tasting is followed by some bittersweet discussion of payment day.

videos.title: Payment Day (5)
videos.overview: On payment day, a number of B&Bers are certain their competitors have been doing some tit-for-tat marking. When the dust settles, who'll win the week?

videos.title: Hotel Penzance (1)
videos.overview: Louise and Daga offer breathtaking views at their place in Cornwall. But forget what's out the window - the B&Bers are preoccupied with their tellies.

videos.title: The Horn of Plenty (2)
videos.overview: Visit two takes the B&Bers to twin sisters Sara and Paula's hotel in Devon. After an afternoon on the lash at a local vineyard, are there sour grapes in the feedback?

videos.title: Angove Guest House (3)
videos.overview: Delightful décor, sumptuous sausages and proper milk await the B&Bers at Simon and Vanessa's coastal guesthouse in Weymouth.

videos.title: The Drayton Crown (4)
videos.overview: The week's final visit is to Jordan and Robin's pub in Somerset. But with one B&Ber dreading the potential of stale ale smell, the hosts have their work cut out.

videos.title: Payment Day (5)
videos.overview: It's payment day: a chance for the B&Bers to complain about specks of dust that they've somehow found after trawling their rooms with a high-powered magnifying glass.

videos.title: Wonderland Retreats Luxury Glamping (1)
videos.overview: Shauna and Sam's Lancashire glampsite boasts a wealth of top-end facilities, including hot tubs, cinema screens and pizza ovens. Is it enough to see them victorious?

videos.title: Optimal Apartments (2)
videos.overview: At luxury self-catering digs in Bradford, the B&Bers aren't sure that flat-pack furniture quite equates to the promised opulence.

videos.title: Impossible Motel, York (3)
videos.overview: At a quirky hotel in York that features a dungeon room full of chains, the B&Bers indulge in some BDSM: bellyaching, disagreeing, stain-hunting and moaning.

videos.title: Beach Suites (4)
videos.overview: Martial arts expert dan hosts the week's final visit in Southport, where he aims to please with his no-nonsense approach to a classic seaside getaway.

videos.title: Payment Day (5)
videos.overview: Allegations of game playing are rife on payment day, with one pair vastly underpaying everyone. You could cut the tension with a best-value-B&B plaque!

videos.title: The Crown Inn (1)
videos.overview: The B&Bers visit an old pub in Kent and do some drag bingo.

videos.title: Kits Coty Glamping (2)
videos.overview: Alarm bells ring for one pair in their bell tent at a plush glampsite in Kent.

videos.title: Stone Court House (3)
videos.overview: Saban hosts at his 700-year-old house in Maidstone, where the magnificent historic vibes aren't enough to stop evening drinks turning terrifically tense.

videos.title: Old Town House (4)
videos.overview: Mark and Anne host at their Margate townhouse, where the atmosphere turns icy over ice cream at the beach thanks to one guest who just can't forget about his own feedback.

videos.title: Payment Day (5)
videos.overview: After a feisty week in Kent - when some B&Bers couldn't even wait until payment day to get their gripes off their chest - it is now actually payment day.
